name: Ano Hi no Hitokoto
source:
The guy I started seeing on the train in April always seemed sad. We've started spending the few minutes it took to get to school together. We went to different schools and were in different grades, and yet, we were gradually bonding...

...at least, that's what we wanted to do.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17566]Freem![/url]]
translation:
我四月份在火车上见到的那个人总是看起来很悲伤。我们开始花几分钟一起去学校。我们去了不同的学校，不同的年级，然而，我们却逐渐变得亲密……

…至少，这就是我们想做的。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/17566]Freem![/url]]
